findings.explanation: INV-1009-A and INV-1009-B are two scans of the same supplier invoice PIS/2026/091 with identical vendor, date (2026-07-15), and amount (141,600 INR), and no cancellation or void record exists to resolve the duplicate.

The purchase order totals 118,000 INR (100,000 subtotal + 18,000 GST) while the invoiced, paid, and posted amount is 141,600 INR (120,000 subtotal + 21,600 GST), a 23,600 INR excess with no amendment or change order explaining it.
No goods receipt note or delivery confirmation document exists anywhere in the transaction to substantiate that the goods were received before the 141,600 INR payment was made.
